limitations: High-polish AI opportunity assessment readouts are often published as templates or proposal decks rather than real client deliverables.
Many executive steering/status packs in the public domain skew public-sector (strong governance artifacts, less design polish than top consulting).
Some highly polished ROI materials are published as slide-style PDFs (reports laid out like decks) rather than PPTX.
